units.source_text: 源氏大将行动十分谨慎小心，谁也不曾觉察。

en.t: General Genji moved with the greatest caution, and no one noticed him.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后看见了他，疑心是做梦。

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo saw him, she wondered if she was dreaming.

units.source_text: 他隔着屏风对皇后说了一大篇花言巧语，作者的笔无法记述。

en.t: From behind the screen, he poured out a long stream of sweet words to the Empress, more than the author can set down in writing.

units.source_text: 然而皇后心君泰然，不为所动。

en.t: Yet the Empress remained calm at heart and was not moved by him.

units.source_text: 后来痛心之极，竟昏迷不省人事。

en.t: Then, overcome with anguish, she finally fainted and lost consciousness.

units.source_text: 贴身侍女王命妇和弁君等大为吃惊，尽力看护扶持。

en.t: Her close attendants, Omyobu, Ben no Kimi, and the others, were greatly alarmed and did all they could to care for and support her.

units.source_text: 源氏大将失望之余，忧恼万状，浑忘前前后后，弄得呆若木鸡。

en.t: General Genji, crushed by disappointment and overwhelmed with distress, lost all sense of what had happened before or after and stood there utterly stunned.

units.source_text: 其时天色渐明，他竟不想回去。

en.t: By then the sky was gradually growing light, yet he still had no wish to leave.

units.source_text: 众侍女闻知皇后患病，纷纷前来看视。

en.t: When the other attendants heard that the Empress had fallen ill, they came one after another to look in on her.

units.source_text: 源氏大将吓得失却知觉，王命妇等便把他推进一个壁橱里，让他躲避。

en.t: General Genji was so frightened that he nearly lost his senses, so Omyobu and the others pushed him into a wall closet to hide him.

units.source_text: 偷偷地给源氏大将送衣服来的侍女也惊恐狼狈之极！

en.t: The maid who had secretly come to bring clothes to General Genji was also terrified and thrown into utter confusion.
